summary: A tight, playable escalation: warning, immediate radio silence, Mahmoud’s necessary objection, then Shalabi’s sharp tactical turn. The dialogue is concise, period-plausible and well differentiated, with «وَلَا هُمَّ» providing the beat’s strongest dramatic pivot.

lines.speaker: MAHMOUD

performance.delivery: Mahmoud gives Shalabi the decoded warning without stopping his careful movement. Keep it precise; the fear appears only in the slight pause after «يَا فَنْدِمْ».

lines.text: يَا فَنْدِمْ… الْقِيَادَةْ رَدِّتْ. الْعَدُوّْ لَقَطْ إِشَارِتْنَا.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: Shalabi decides before the danger can spread through the column. Give each imperative cleanly and quietly, with no visible debate.

lines.text: اِقْفِلْ الْجِهَازْ. مَحَدِّشْ يِفْتَحْ لَاسِلْكِي لِحَدّْ مَا أَقُولْ.

lines.speaker: MAHMOUD

performance.delivery: Mahmoud is not challenging command; he is making sure Shalabi has accepted the operational cost. His thumb remains over the switch as he speaks.

lines.text: كِدَهْ الْقِيَادَةْ مِشْ هَتِعْرَفْ إِحْنَا فِينْ يَا فَنْدِمْ.

performance.delivery: Shalabi answers Mahmoud directly, almost under his breath. Let the tiny pause before «هُمَّ» reveal that he has already weighed both risks.
Sayed quietly voices what the experienced men are thinking. Keep it gravelly and practical, without turning it into panic or a challenge.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: Shalabi points out the new direction while resetting the bearing. The first sentence diagnoses the trap; after the pause, the second quietly takes back the initiative.

lines.text: مِسْتَنِّيِّينَّا عَ السِّكَّةْ اللِّي عَارْفِينْهَا. هَنْلِفّْ… وِنِطْلَعْلُهُمْ مِنْ حِتَّةْ تَانْيَةْ.
